programmes.d: Deer patrols on the firearm opener as well as later in the season by Michigan conservation officers.

Michigan conservation officers contact observe salmon anglers during the busy fall salmon spawning run. Also, segments on the Gladwin Field Trial Area and officers lend a hand in getting toys to underpriveleged children for Christmas.

Michigan conservation officers in districts 1 and 5 check out snowmobilers and ice anglers. Also, a look into trying to get an accurate moose count from a plane and conservation officers who help to gather toys for children for Christmas.
Michigan Conservation Officers patrol salmon fishermen, another CO shares his turkey hunting expertise with a hunter safety class, and a look into the DNR's efforts to place bands onto geese.

Two Michigan conservation officers in the southern part of the state investigate a case of deer carcasses they found near some railroad tracks. Also, a look at an opportunity for veterans and first responders to hunt pheasants.
An 18 year-old elk hunter in Montana is seriously injured by a bear.
Two teenagers go fishing in a less than seaworthy boat when a riptide drags them into the Atlantic ocean.
Three friends sky diving trip goes horribly wrong when their plane gets caught by a storm.
A treasure hunter gets lost in the Australian Outback and struggles to survive wild dingoes.
Four men fight for their lives against the very animals they have dedicated themselves to protect.
Tom defends his home against a bear threat while Morgan makes a deadly miscalculation on thin ice.
Morgan gets caught in the grips of an ice desert with no shelter in sight and Marty's return to Alaska's Revelation Mountains takes an unexpected turn.
Morgan climbs into the treacherous Alaska Range; Rich goes to war with the wolves.
Morgan walks into a death trap in the Alaska Range when a whiteout strikes in an avalanche zone.
Marty discovers an unexpected advantage and Rich mounts a search for a lost friend.
The men arrive in Iceland to find their jet ski is still in transit. Snow and Ice hamper the crew’s departure. The team finds a village buried by a volcano.
New crewmember Scott gets his first taste of an angry ocean. Relentless high sea’s put the entire expedition on a new course.
The expedition makes another attempt to reach the Shetland Islands on Easter Sunday. Steven struggles to keep Scott focused on the teams mission. The crew reaches Europe.
The men travel south down the coast of Denmark getting a first hand look at World War 2 bunkers. The expedition’s main GPS fails miles from shore.
